meaning: A picture of exactly what is showing on your phone's screen. You can save it or send it to someone.
clues: It has to do with what you see on your phone's screen.
It's one still picture of the screen, not a video.
You make one by pressing two buttons on the phone at the same time.
Once it's taken, you can edit it, share it, or find it later in your Photos.
It has ten letters and starts with S.
assumes: A video is not a still picture
A wallpaper is not a picture of the screen

decoys.meaning: A video of what happens on your phone's screen. It is saved on the phone and can include sound.
The background picture on your phone's home screen or lock screen.
A code, pattern, or fingerprint you use to open your phone and keep other people out.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: So the phone keeps a copy of whatever is on its screen? Handy for a confirmation you want to hold on to.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open any screen, then press the buttons your phone uses to take one. Apple and Google both have a short help page.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Then open your Photos app to find it. iPhone and Android both keep it there.

sources.name: Apple Support, Take a screenshot on your iPhone
Android Help, Take a screenshot or record your screen

blank.sentence: I pressed two buttons to make my ___, a still picture of the confirmation page.

why: It lets you keep a confirmation or share exactly what you see.
short: A picture of your phone screen

situations.text: A screenshot is one still picture of what is showing on your phone screen.
situations.why: It is a still picture, not a video. A screen recording is the video.
